title: Rampaging White Horse
description: A large white horse with black spots rears up on its hind legs in the center of the image, its mane and tail flowing wildly. It is surrounded by broken orange bricks, shattered red wooden beams, and debris against a black background, with a small hiker figure standing in a lavender field to the right observing the chaos.
prompt: A majestic white horse with black dapples rears wildly on its hind legs in the center of a black void, its mane and tail flowing in motion. It bursts through a pile of shattered orange bricks and broken red wooden beams with nails, debris flying everywhere. In the lower right, a small backpacking hiker stands in a field of purple lavender flowers, looking up at the horse in surprise. Surreal fantasy scene with starry background and distant mountains.
